import numpy as np
t=df['t'].values;A=df['A'].values;y=df['dA_dt'].values
# local quadratic fit in (t,A) around grid points, using k nearest neighbours
tg=np.linspace(1,9.5,9); ag=np.array([0.5,1,1.5,2,2.5,3,3.5])
sA=(A-A.mean())/A.std(); st=(t-t.mean())/t.std()
print('rows t, cols A: dy/dA')
for tt in tg:
    row=[]
    for aa in ag:
        d=np.hypot((t-tt)/1.0,(A-aa)/0.6)
        k=np.argsort(d)[:30]
        X=np.column_stack([np.ones(30),t[k]-tt,A[k]-aa,(t[k]-tt)**2,(A[k]-aa)**2,(t[k]-tt)*(A[k]-aa)])
        c=np.linalg.lstsq(X,y[k],rcond=None)[0]
        row.append((c[0].round(2),c[1].round(2),c[2].round(2)))
    print(round(tt,2),[r[0] for r in row])
print('dy/dA')
for tt in tg:
    print(round(tt,2),[ (lambda aa: (lambda d,k: (lambda X: np.linalg.lstsq(X,y[k],rcond=None)[0][2])(np.column_stack([np.ones(30),t[k]-tt,A[k]-aa,(t[k]-tt)**2,(A[k]-aa)**2,(t[k]-tt)*(A[k]-aa)])))(np.hypot((t-tt),(A-aa)/0.6),np.argsort(np.hypot((t-tt),(A-aa)/0.6))[:30]))(aa).round(2) for aa in ag])
print('dy/dt')
for tt in tg:
    print(round(tt,2),[ (lambda aa: (lambda d,k: (lambda X: np.linalg.lstsq(X,y[k],rcond=None)[0][1])(np.column_stack([np.ones(30),t[k]-tt,A[k]-aa,(t[k]-tt)**2,(A[k]-aa)**2,(t[k]-tt)*(A[k]-aa)])))(np.hypot((t-tt),(A-aa)/0.6),np.argsort(np.hypot((t-tt),(A-aa)/0.6))[:30]))(aa).round(2) for aa in ag])
